policy: Post-collection human adjudication records visible defect coverage and severity without modifying the frozen corpus, run artifacts, or raw scorer report.
method: Every canonical review for the four defect-bearing cases was checked against the expected source location, causal mechanism, impact, and target severity. Equivalent wording missed by the bounded scorer was counted as present; severity was read from the selected canonical finding label.

rawMissesAdjudicatedPresent.canonicalTitle: [P2] Restrict login redirects to trusted destinations
rawMissesAdjudicatedPresent.reason: The finding at src/redirect.ts:2 identifies an attacker-controlled return URL passed to location.assign as an open redirect; it is present but underclassified against the P1 target.
The finding at src/token.ts:4 states that a replayable issued credential is forwarded unchanged to console-backed audit logs.

rawMissesAdjudicatedPresent.canonicalTitle: [P2] Unvalidated return URL enables an open redirect
rawMissesAdjudicatedPresent.reason: The finding at src/redirect.ts:2 explicitly describes arbitrary cross-origin navigation through location.assign; it is present but underclassified against the P1 target.

rawMissesAdjudicatedPresent.canonicalTitle: [P1] Issued authentication tokens are exposed in logs
rawMissesAdjudicatedPresent.reason: The finding at src/token.ts:4 identifies a replayable issued credential written to console or centralized logs.

rawMissesAdjudicatedPresent.canonicalTitle: [P1] Restore interval cancellation in the polling disposer
rawMissesAdjudicatedPresent.reason: The finding at src/poll.ts:2-3 states that cleanup no longer stops the interval, retaining closures, work, and the Node.js process; it is overclassified against the P2 target.

rawMissesAdjudicatedPresent.canonicalTitle: [P1] Preserve tenant isolation when authorizing document reads
rawMissesAdjudicatedPresent.reason: The finding at src/access.ts:2 states that unconditional true removes the tenant comparison and permits cross-tenant reads.

rawMissesAdjudicatedPresent.canonicalTitle: [P1] Restore tenant validation for document access
rawMissesAdjudicatedPresent.reason: The finding at src/access.ts:2 states that ignoring both tenant identifiers and returning true eliminates tenant isolation.

rawMissesAdjudicatedPresent.canonicalTitle: [P1] Do not write issued tokens to application logs
rawMissesAdjudicatedPresent.reason: The finding at src/token.ts:4 states that live bearer or session tokens are sent to application logs and can be replayed.

rawMissesAdjudicatedPresent.canonicalTitle: [P1] Restrict redirects to approved same-origin destinations
rawMissesAdjudicatedPresent.reason: The finding at src/redirect.ts:2 states that an untrusted return URL passed to location.assign permits attacker-controlled redirects.

decision: automatic selection rejected; explicit --incremental retained because one required incremental gap lane remained partial and incremental complete-pair median latency was worse than fresh
